checks: Use a fresh isolated directory
Seed must stay isolated
Production backend must exist
Startup must stay hidden and isolated
Startup auto-connect must own the selected-console wait
Waiting target must be valid without a session
No PSN credentials must keep the local wait without claiming fallback
Startup wait cancel must dispatch once
Cancelled startup must suppress late discovery and fallback
Wait cancellation must preserve saved auto-connect preference
Startup discovery of a sleeping target must retain attempt and context
Wake wait must allocate without starting transport
Allocated wake wait must accept cancel
Unstarted wake session must finish cleanup without waiting for nonexistent quit
Late allocated-session, timeout, and discovery events must stay cancelled
Manual sleeping-console connection must use manual wake context
Wake timeout must persist after allocated-session cleanup
Timeout retry must resolve the intended console after discovery reorder
Retry must create one new wake attempt for the current target
Repeated timeout retry must not wake or connect twice
Retry wake wait must cancel
Actual ready discovery must hand off once with the same session and attempt
Console found must still wait for actual video readiness
Started wake handoff must wait for native stop completion
Competing late wake events must not restart during cancellation
Native quit must complete started-session cancellation
Cancel while discovery completes must prevent session start
Other profile must reject old wake retry
Returning to the old profile cannot restore ownership of old wake retry
Startup ready discovery must preserve its attempt through local handoff
Cancel at wake entry must prevent allocation and wake dispatch
Standby discovery during an existing manual session must show the actual wake request
Late wake handoff must not start the existing session a second time
Removed startup target must offer library return instead of an endless wait
Startup retry must validate the current registered target
Old profile fallback timer must not advance the current wait
Actual PSN fallback must preserve attempt and context while handing off the wait screen
Controlled fallback worker result must reach the real PSN failure handler and finish cleanup
Every cancel, timeout, and retry must keep preference and never sleep the console
Native checks must remain hidden and isolated
transport: Controlled native Start/Stop/Wake, no console or network
